title: Best robot lawn mower deal: Save $220 on the Roborock RockNeo Q110H robot lawn mower
excerpt: Score a Roborock robot lawn mower with a record price cut.
content_html:
SAVE $220: As of Sept. 30, the Roborock RockNeo Q110H robot lawn mower is marked down to $679.99 at Amazon. That's $220 off the regular list price of $799.99.

Credit: Roborock

$679.99 at Amazon
$799.99 Save $120

You've got to love a sale event like October Prime Day — one of those rare opportunities to stock up on the devices and tech that cost more than your budget will allow for most of the year. That includes the robot lawn mower, a luxury device that's usually stuck firmly at a premium price point.

Prime Day isn't quite here yet — it starts properly on Oct. 6 and runs for 48 hours — but some deals have arrived early, including a tempting discount on the Roborock RockNeo Q110H robot lawn mower.

As of Sept. 30, the Roborock RockNeo Q110H robot lawn mower is marked down to $679.99 on Amazon, a $220 saving on the regular list price of $799.99. According to price tracker camelcamelcamel, that's a record-low price for this model — and by a significant margin.

If you know anything about robot vacuums, you'll already know that Roborock is one of the key names in that category. It stands to reason that the brand knows its stuff when it comes to the garden.

Controlled by the Roborock app, the RockNeo Q110H has an arsenal of smart features all designed to get the garden in excellent shape with zero effort from you. It offers smart mapping and navigation, plus AI-assisted obstacle avoidance. It then puts the finishing touches to the mowing with close edge cutting and even climbs over some obstacles. Meanwhile, a floating cutting deck helps it deal with bumpy and uneven ground so the grass length is always consistent. If you do have an uneven garden, it can handle a 45% slope.
